findings.summary: No Saturday collection: Sunday brief would miss Friday close and latest COT
findings.reason: Adopted as design ruling D1: Saturday 07:00 refresh added; Sunday job refreshes data before generating the brief.

findings.summary: Mock CME snapshots indistinguishable from real on data branch
findings.reason: Adopted as D2: provenance source=mock|real on every snapshot row; production config rejects mock; UI badges mock data.

findings.summary: Options dimension 30% weight with chronically absent OI sub-score unspecified
findings.reason: Adopted as D3: explicit sub-scores (skew/IV automated; OI manual) with within-dimension weight renormalization and per-sub-score reliability.

findings.summary: Aggregate bias toward neutral when a dimension is missing (0-fill with intact weight)
findings.reason: Adopted as D4: weights renormalize over present dimensions; reliability floor 0.5 suppresses bucket label to 'insufficient data'.

findings.summary: as_of-only filtering ignores publication lag (COT Friday release, FRED +1d)
findings.reason: Adopted as D5: available_at column per row; engines filter as_of<=T AND available_at<=T; freshness vs publication cadence.

findings.summary: GC=F roll gaps corrupt structure metrics
findings.reason: Adopted as D6: roll detection + difference-splice back-adjustment for structure metrics; roll weeks flagged.

findings.summary: Staleness limits not tied to real publication cadence (COT ~10d, FRED lag, weekly ETF)
findings.reason: Adopted as D7: per-source cadence-based limits in config.

findings.summary: No missed-run recovery for in-process APScheduler
findings.reason: Adopted as D8: misfire_grace_time, coalesce, startup catch-up rules.

findings.summary: One flaky collector fails the whole refresh
findings.reason: Adopted as D9: refresh fan-in; failed source marked missing, job continues.

findings.summary: Actions workflow missing permissions/concurrency/UTC cron; 'raw URL token optional' wrong for private branch
findings.reason: Adopted as D10: contents:write, concurrency group, UTC cron documented; GITHUB_DATA_TOKEN required for snapshot pull.

findings.summary: TPO from daily bars is an approximation presented as authoritative
findings.reason: Owner-frozen spec builds structure from daily bars (SPEC §4.1 permits volume proxy); MVP keeps the approximation, adopted as D11: pinned VA algorithm (70% two-sided expansion from POC) + explicit 'daily-bar approximation' labeling in UI and API payloads.

findings.summary: FRED series 'DXY10Y' does not exist
findings.reason: Live-verified 27 Nov 2026 (HTML error from fredgraph.csv?id=DXY10Y; DFII10/DGS10/DTWEXBGS verified working) — substituted DTWEXBGS as D18; matrix REQ-2 updated.

findings.summary: Missing-forever and cold-start (insufficient history) failure modes untested
findings.reason: Adopted in D3/D4 semantics + REQ-13; minimum-history threshold marks history-dependent metrics 'insufficient' instead of computing garbage.

findings.summary: Replay not reproducible across config changes
findings.reason: Adopted as D14: snapshots store bias config + SHA-256; replay uses snapshotted config; REQ-16 added.

findings.summary: Optional LLM report path unconstrained
findings.reason: Adopted as D15: MVP ships no LLM client; deterministic formatting only; test asserts no network/LLM calls.

findings.summary: Manual import path unvalidated/untested
findings.reason: Adopted as D16: schema+date validation, idempotent upsert, provenance manual; REQ-15 added (incl. economic calendar import, D13).

findings.summary: TradingView anonymous scanner fragility unaddressed
findings.reason: Library choice ratified by owner (decisions.md); adopted D17 mitigation: pacing + bounded backoff + graceful missing-flag degradation. Residual risk of IP-block accepted.

findings.summary: Forming daily bar at 07:00 refresh breaks reproducibility
findings.reason: Adopted as D12: completed bars only; today's bar excluded from engine inputs.

findings.summary: Weekend/trading-calendar blind staleness
findings.reason: Covered by D7 cadence-based limits (e.g. COT 10d, manual 14d) sized to survive weekends/holidays without alarm fatigue.

findings.summary: Economic calendar silently dropped from plan
findings.reason: Adopted as D13: manual CSV import path + report question 7 answered from imported data or explicit absence; REQ-15.

findings.summary: Weak matrix controls REQ-1/5/9
findings.reason: REQ-1 now requires golden-fixture equality; REQ-5 requires mobile CSS + reliability/insufficient-state rendering; REQ-9 adds provenance assertion and records the real-login untested risk explicitly as accepted-risk pending Poom's secrets.

findings.summary: Headline bias label not gated by reliability
findings.reason: Adopted in D4: reliability floor 0.5 → headline 'insufficient data — no directional call'.

findings.summary: Playbook pre-marked implementation steps completed before evidence exists
findings.reason: Playbook steps 6-11 and acceptance table reset to pending; statuses flip only when evidence files are real.

findings.summary: Port 8600 exposed on public VPS with unauthenticated refresh endpoint
findings.reason: Adopted as D19: compose binds 127.0.0.1 only; access via SSH tunnel; LAN exposure documented as explicit future accepted risk.

findings.summary: VA algorithm unspecified
findings.reason: Adopted in D11: POC = max-volume proxy bucket; VA = smallest POC-centered band covering 70% of proxy volume.

resolution: 25 findings adopted as binding design rulings D1-D19 in plan.md and matrix extensions REQ-13..REQ-16; 2 accepted risks (TPO daily-bar approximation with pinned algorithm + explicit labeling; TradingView anonymous-scanner fragility with pacing/backoff mitigation). Design re-frozen after fixes; both reviewers ran in fresh isolated contexts with only the design files.
